accepted_candidate_reason: No candidate satisfies the four-gate joint requirement (primary method per MEASUREMENT_METHOD_HIERARCHY.md §2.1, K and C operationalisations per CLAIM_BOUNDARY.md §4.3, five-family null requirement per NULL_MODEL_HIERARCHY.md §2, public-bundle plus preregistered acceptance window) at the time of this audit. NONE is therefore selected fail-closed.
decision_reason: Canon does not yet provide a fungal-electrophysiology row in SUBSTRATE_MEASUREMENT_TABLE.yaml, a fungal entry in MEASUREMENT_METHOD_HIERARCHY.md §5, fungal calibrations of OU and latent-variable nulls, a preregistered acceptance interval in PREREG_TEMPLATE_GAMMA.md, or an external public bundle. Each candidate γ definition fails on at least one of these four gates; several fail on multiple. The fail-closed protocol blocks biological-pipeline work until a follow-up canon PR amends those documents.
forbidden_promotions: secondary metrics cannot promote the claim
no gamma definition changes after seeing fungal results
no universality claim from this substrate alone
method_risks: DFA cannot serve as primary per MEASUREMENT_METHOD_HIERARCHY.md §2.3; promoting it contradicts frozen canon
specparam / IRASA cannot be interpreted without fungal-specific K and C operationalisations
CSN avalanche analysis requires a canonical fungal-spike detector that does not yet exist in the repo
Theil-Sen K(C) requires K and C definitions that do not yet exist for fungal mycelium
OU null requires fungal-specific autocorrelation calibration that does not yet exist in NULL_MODEL_HIERARCHY.md §2.3
Latent-variable null (Morrell, Nemenman & Sederberg 2024) requires a fungal-substrate latent model class that does not yet exist in NULL_MODEL_HIERARCHY.md §2.5
No external public bundle (Zenodo / institutional archive) is registered for fungal electrophysiology under CLAIM_BOUNDARY.md §5.1 gate (a)

rejected_candidates.reason: DFA is secondary cross-check only per MEASUREMENT_METHOD_HIERARCHY.md §2.3; promoting it to primary contradicts frozen canon. Touboul & Destexhe 2021 show DFA passes crackling-noise tests on non-critical systems. Conversion gamma = 2H + 1 with gamma approximately 1.0 forces H approximately 0, which is biologically non-trivial for fungal recordings (slow drift, electrode polarisation, and burst structure typically yield H above 0.5).

Method aligns with primary canon (specparam + IRASA, MEASUREMENT_METHOD_HIERARCHY.md §2.1) but cannot be accepted today because no fungal-specific K and C operationalisations exist in SUBSTRATE_MEASUREMENT_TABLE.yaml, no fungal OU calibration exists in NULL_MODEL_HIERARCHY.md §2.3, and no preregistered acceptance interval exists in PREREG_TEMPLATE_GAMMA.md.

Clauset-Shalizi-Newman framework would require a canonical fungal-spike detector (none exists in the repo) and the spatial-correlation convergence test required by MEASUREMENT_METHOD_HIERARCHY.md §2.3 cannot be met by typical Adamatzky-style electrode geometries without a substrate-specific spatial-criticality amendment.

Theil-Sen K(C) regression requires fungal-specific K (topological complexity proxy) and C (thermodynamic cost proxy) definitions; none exist in SUBSTRATE_MEASUREMENT_TABLE.yaml. Choosing them ad hoc would constitute data-driven metric switching forbidden by CLAIM_BOUNDARY.md §6.

Multifractal DFA spectrum width (per §2.3, Aguilera 2015 critique)
